{{Short description|French astrophysicist}}
{{BLP sources|date=January 2016}}
'''Éric Aubourg''' is a French astrophysicist at the [[Commissariat à l'Énergie Atomique]] and a member of the [[Astroparticle and Cosmology Laboratory#Cosmology|APC/Université Paris-Diderot Cosmology Group]].<ref name="parisdiderot" />  

==Life==
Éric Aubourg has published several contributions to Egyptology, including a dating of the [[Dendera zodiac]], whose age was a subject of 19th-century archaeological debate.  

He also likely authored MacScribe, a hieroglyph-typesetting software for [[Mac (computer)|Macintosh]] which originated from the same department he collaborated with on the Dendera dating, and is attributed to someone with his name.
